As Flexion Therapeutics (FLXN) Share Price Declined, Peconic Partners Lifted by $13.71 Million Its Stake; Rock Point Advisors Boosted Its Holding in Newell Rubbermaid (NWL) by $2.91 Million 
April 23, 2018 - By Henry Gaston 
William Harnisch increased its stake in Flexion Therapeutics Inc (FLXN) by 548.25% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Peconic Partners Llc bought 548,248 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.56% with the market. The hedge fund run by William Harnisch held 648,248 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.23 million, up from 100,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Peconic Partners Llc who had been investing in Flexion Therapeutics Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $917.54 million market cap company. The stock decreased 1.37% or $0.34 during the last trading session, reaching $24.39. About 264,302 shares traded. Flexion Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXN) has declined 21.46% since April 23, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.01% the S&P500.
